lines.4: 「Hm? Scared? He may look like an ordinary thug, but sometimes he gives us huge pieces of bubble gum.」
lines.5: 「Hey, is that my only selling point?」
lines.9: 「Nothing is impossible. Yoppi might confess her love to me someday.」
lines.13: 「But how did he lose his memory?」
lines.17: 「Damn! My Tsutenkaku pitch didn't work! You're good!」
lines.18: 「The blonde over there playing tabletop baseball did it.」
lines.19: 「...Please accept our apologies for the trouble Ellie caused.」
lines.20: 「Princess! Leo lost his memory! This isn't the time for tabletop baseball!」
lines.21: 「I'm not the one who lost her memory.」
